verdicts.reason: Both use the same stacked recomposition. In both, the '&'/Baby Toddler lockup is pushed off-centre to the right, so it doesn't share an axis with the centred BEDDING. Both also leave the blue photo strip as an odd floating sliver with the dot grids crowding it, and the left dot field sits empty. A is slightly better: its BEDDING is larger and sits closer to the bottom, which gives a stronger hierarchy and fuller use of the canvas. B's smaller BEDDING leaves a dead band at the bottom, and its photo strip runs nearly to the canvas edges.
